overview: The Historical Commission rejected a demolition application for 8 Suffolk Street for lack of jurisdiction and reviewed proposed zoning changes along Boston Avenue. The commission also received updates on municipal art cataloging, ongoing cemetery and park preservation projects, and Section 106 reviews.

items.title: 8 Suffolk Street Demolition Application
items.summary: Rejected the demolition application on the grounds of non-jurisdiction due to insufficient demolition work.

items.title: Boston Avenue Zoning Discussion
items.summary: Doug Carr presented proposed zoning maps for Boston Avenue North and South, detailing recommendations to reduce proposed building heights and scale back commercial boundaries encroaching into residential side streets.

items.title: Salem Street Burying Ground
items.summary: Agreed to defer a request from descendants to clean the Sarah Bradley Fulton memorial to the cemetery trustees.

items.title: Citywide Art Inventory
items.summary: Discussed drafting a scope of work to locate past municipal art records, assess valuations, and explore display opportunities for city-owned artwork.

items.title: Budget Update and Hegner Center
items.summary: Received confirmation that the commission requested a level budget for the upcoming year and noted preliminary discussions regarding the Hegner Center.

items.title: Preservation Projects and Section 106 Updates
items.summary: Discussed the pending Section 106 review for Medford High School, completed tree work at Thomas Brooks Park, ground-penetrating radar bidding for the Cross Street burial grounds, and contract extension funding for Hastings Heights survey forms.

items.title: Section 106 Review: 59–75 Valley Street
items.summary: Agreed to pass on review with no comment regarding telecommunications equipment replacement at 59–75 Valley Street.

items.title: Brooks Estate Parking Lot
items.summary: Discussed permeable pavement requirements and bid preparations for the Brooks Estate parking lot.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from May 2026.
